name: Handicraft & Handloom Production
description: Artisanal handloom textiles, terracotta craft, and regional bamboo products. Low fixed capital barrier, high margin potential, relies on design and market connections.

name: Dairy & Milk Collection Center
description: Small-scale dairy cattle management, chilled milk aggregation, and supply to regional cooperative dairies. High asset requirement, steady recurring cash flow.

name: Grain Milling & Food Processing Unit
description: Micro-milling of pulses, spices, oilseeds, and flour with custom local packaging. Benefits from proximity to agricultural produce.

name: Vermicompost & Bio-Fertilizer Unit
description: Organic fertilizer manufacturing utilizing cattle manure, agricultural biomass, and earthworm beds. High margin, eco-sustainable, and strong local farmer demand.

name: Rural Logistics & Agri-Retail Store
description: Last-mile input supply (certified seeds, farm tools, animal feed) combined with local aggregation transport to nearby mandi/markets.
